rules: Plant-like enemies (Flowermen, Dendroids, Swarms): burn them.
Anything with a human head: aim for the head.
Tiny chasers (Seeds, Mimics): don't waste ammo. One shot or a melee hit.
A car that moves by itself: shoot the windshield, back off before it dies.
Statues freeze while watched; Shy Girl attacks if you stare. Know which is which.

threats.name: Distorted
threats.does: Lies dormant like a pile of clothes until noise wakes it, then dashes and short-teleports at you.
beat: Suppressed headshot while it's still asleep is the safest kill.
Don't open up on a sleeping group with a loud rifle; it wakes the rest.
Lair variants scream to summon more. Kill the screamer first.

threats.name: Hunter Distorted
threats.does: Echolocation pulse finds you through walls from about 100 m.
beat: When you hear the pulse, assume you're spotted and move off doorways and open ground.
Kill it fast with concentrated fire or headshots.

threats.name: Flowerman
threats.does: Hides in vegetation near bright orange lure flowers. Dashes at you and knocks your aim.
beat: Taking Active Matter near the orange flowers wakes the nest. Prepare first.
Fire (Molotov, incendiary, flamethrower) is the best answer; they're armored but burn.
They're tied to their nest: back away from it and they give up.
0.4.0.201 shortened the gaps between their dashes, so expect faster follow-ups.
threats.drops: Nests hold a lot of Active Matter.

threats.name: Alpha Flowerman
threats.does: Huge, slow Flowerman guarding a big nest with an escort.
beat: Burn the escort first, then focus the Alpha.
Its head armor comes off last, so headshots aren't the quick win.
Use its slowness to keep distance.

threats.name: Dendroid
threats.does: Tree-like humanoid; some melee, some carry guns.
beat: Set them on fire; a burning Dendroid tries to flee.
Fight armed ones from cover like a soldier.

threats.name: Devourer
threats.does: Turret-like monster whose ranged attack goes through walls. Guards Cargo Port's barges and teleporters.
beat: Wait for its attack behind cover, then return fire, and repeat.
Each wall its shot passes through cuts the damage, so cover still helps.
Pump shotgun (MB590/SPAS-12) up close saves ammo versus automatics.
In Ozernoe: Firestorm, burning Devourers can be neutralized quickly with a fire extinguisher.
threats.drops: About 25–30 Active Matter and Devourer remains.

threats.name: Hellhounds
threats.does: Fast packs that try to surround you. Dens are marked by vertical tears in space.
beat: Backpedal and kill the closest one; don't let them circle you.
They're fragile: melee saves rifle ammo.
No longer spawn on rooftops (0.4.0.163).

threats.name: Invisible
threats.does: Almost transparent; you see a shimmer or hear it first. Hits players who stand still.
beat: Keep moving while you loot.
Buckshot beats trying to aim at a shimmer.
Get into water: they won't follow.

threats.name: Shy Girl
threats.does: Mannequin-like figure in a blur. Staring at her makes her attack, even through glass.
beat: Look away immediately if you catch sight of her.
If you fight, use heavy fire from cover and never in a narrow corridor.

threats.name: Statue
threats.does: Frozen while you watch it, rushes you when you look away.
beat: Usually skip it: keep looking at it and back out of the area.
Bullets barely work. Use grenades if you must kill it.

threats.name: Mimic
threats.does: Small black tendril creature hiding in ordinary objects, then crawls on walls and ceilings.
beat: One or two melee hits usually kill it.
If several swarm you, switch to short bursts.

threats.name: Alpha Mimic / Mimic Car
threats.does: A car that turns into a giant walker. Explodes when it dies.
beat: Don't walk up to suspicious cars.
Shoot through the windshield.
Back away as its health drops, and stay clear of fuel tanks and other cars.
threats.drops: About 10× more Active Matter since 0.4.0.156; random weapons, armor and rare attachments.

threats.name: Scorch
threats.does: Glowing fire creature that charges and throws a fireball. Main threat in the Ozernoe: Firestorm Overtime Raid.
beat: Shoot it while it's charging, or in the gap right after it fires.
Don't stand in the leftover fire.
A fire extinguisher (equip it in a weapon slot) neutralizes it within seconds so it doesn't explode.

threats.name: Swarm
threats.does: Cloud of small flying creatures.
beat: Get under any roof or into a closed vehicle cab. The Ozernoe church is safe.
A flamethrower clears them; shotguns are weak.

threats.name: Poltergeist
threats.does: Rattles doors and moves objects, waking nearby monsters.
beat: Close doors behind you.
Deal with whatever it wakes before chasing it.
Players report mixed results with flamethrowers; grenades work.

threats.name: Turned Soldier
threats.does: Armed former soldiers who use cover, fight in groups and sometimes retreat.
beat: Fight them like players: hard cover, peeks, controlled shots.
Pick off the long-range shooters first.
threats.drops: Always drop enriched loot. Best PvE farm target.

threats.name: Police & SWAT
threats.does: Armed patrols in Downtown.
beat: Pull them apart one at a time.
They fight monsters too, so let them thin out threats.

threats.name: Seeds
threats.does: Small glowing red floating mines that chase you once triggered.
beat: One rifle round or two pistol rounds each.
Backpedal through cleared ground while shooting them one by one.
They give up the chase sooner since 0.4.0.163.

threats.name: Ball Lightning
threats.does: Drawn by noise; explodes on contact, injuring limbs, flipping vehicles and waking monsters.
beat: Never melee it.
Shoot it from cover at range; it appears about 45 m out.
It no longer spawns right on top of players (0.4.0.201).

threats.name: Fireball
threats.does: Patrols near scorched ground and bursts into fire when destroyed.
beat: Go around it when you can.
If not, shoot from range and don't walk in right after it pops.

threats.name: Gravity anomalies
threats.does: Some let you walk on walls and ceilings; others fling or stun you.
beat: Toss a cheap throwable to test a suspicious patch.
Don't waste ammo shooting traps.
Floating houses and barges are usually reached through a nearby portal.
threats.drops: Nothing directly, but they guard loot.

threats.name: Tentacle
threats.does: Added with the Gigastructure update.
beat: Listen for its sound and find it before you move closer.
